encounter: E0011 TRAINER_JAMES_1; playtest block P1, cap 14, attempt 1
availability_audit: Every member is drawn from work/reference-pools/pool-14.json with gate<=14, the legality rule this playtest brief uses for the cap-14 window. Roots are recorded per member. Caveat carried in each receipt: some cap-14 roots (VerdanturfMeadow, RustboroCity_DevonCorp_2F, Route115/116, AlteringCave) sit later in campaign chronology than the Route 102/103/104 fights in this block, so this is a cap-window-legal party, not a party a player literally holds at Petalburg Woods. Held items are ordinary free preparation-catalogue items, one of each, no duplicates.
plan: James is four Bugs, two of them part Water, so the party splits the answer. Magearna leads: Steel resists Bug outright, is immune to Venipede's Poison Jab and Poison Touch lane, and its Thunderbolt is 2x on both Water/Bug members - the 'focused attacks on the rain lead' the dossier names. Arcanine partners it for Fire pressure on the two pure-Bug members and Intimidate against the physical Bug Bite/Liquidation core, and it is switched out rather than left in if rain goes up. Snorlax is the rain-proof body, Weavile's Knock Off strips two Eviolites and a Life Orb, and Whimsicott's Prankster Taunt answers the Rain Dance turn directly.
